reason: Run the V21 Release Closure Program Lane C audits in one evidence batch on fresh trusted main: Fresh-main Release Audit V2, Mandatory Executed-Test Coverage Audit, and Aug-20-to-current-main Delta Regression Audit. This work package may update only the Release Closure Ledger with mechanically verified audit results; executable/source repairs discovered by the audit require independent causal work packages.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().

requiredSemantics: Audit fresh trusted main independently across renderer and reachable controls, Electron/backend ownership and lifecycle, credential/security boundaries, Store/identity/conversation truth, physical adapters and durable repair, Durable Execution, AI Core, dependency/supply-chain state, and release packaging/sealed-runtime boundaries.
For every release-critical contract inspected, distinguish executed exact-head coverage from file presence or stale ancestor evidence.
Audit post-2026-08-20 changes for regressions, authority duplication, contract drift, dependency/postinstall/dynamic-download changes, unreachable Product surfaces, and stale tests.
Append immutable A2-P0/A2-P1 or DELTA-P0/DELTA-P1 rows for newly discovered blockers rather than hiding them inside narrative text.
Where an audit exposes an executable/source blocker, record it and require a separate failure-first causal repair batch; this documentation work package grants no repair authority.
Do not mark the fresh Windows RC, final ledger closure, release readiness, formal release, or publish complete.
forbiddenSemantics: No CLOSED or PACKAGED_RC_PASS without the future fresh packaged Windows RC evidence.
No coverage PASS inferred from test-file presence, workflow existence, skipped applicable tests, or ancestor runs.
No audit-complete claim while an identified audit surface remains uninspected or a discovered P0/P1 lacks an explicit ledger row.
